DELETE FROM target_prerequisite
WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
    ('concept', 'css.grid', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.dom-events', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.event-state', 'v1')
)
OR (prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version) IN (
    ('concept', 'html.structure', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'javascript.dom-basics', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.dom-events', 'v1')
);

DELETE FROM learning_target
WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
    ('concept', 'html.structure', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'css.grid', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'javascript.dom-basics', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.dom-events', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'javascript.event-state', 'v1')
);
